evals.prompt: 我是小白，带我在不改代码的前提下快速看懂这个开源项目。先讲整体架构，再带我沿一条真实用户请求读代码。
evals.expected_output: A beginner-friendly, evidence-backed architecture map, one real end-to-end path with clickable published-source links when a remote is available, one active-recall question, and focused next lessons.

evals.prompt: 我准备给认证模块提 PR。请循序渐进带我学习，不要直接替我改代码；每个关键点先问我一个问题。
evals.expected_output: A contribution-oriented guided lesson that traces the authentication path, identifies relevant contracts and tests, asks one prediction at a time, and does not change code.

evals.prompt: 复习我上次学到的请求处理流程，然后继续讲错误处理和重试逻辑。
evals.expected_output: A retrieval-first follow-up lesson that distinguishes confirmed source behavior from runtime assumptions and continues with error-handling evidence.
